title: OnlyFans is in advanced talks to sell Architect Capital a below 20% stake at a $3B+ valuation, down from a previously reported ~60% stake at a ~$5.5B valuation (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: OnlyFans is in advanced talks to sell Architect Capital a below 20% stake at a $3B+ valuation, down from a previously reported ~60% stake at a ~$5.5B valuation — Discussions with Architect Capital come less than a month after the UK-based platform's owner Leonid Radvinsky died
